children: Shares of Reliance Industries Ltd (RIL) were among top Nifty gainers on September 4 by rising 2%. The heavyweight stock also crossed the key technical level of 100-DMA.
At 12 pm on September 4, RIL shares were trading 2% higher at Rs 1,328.6 apiece.
Last week, Jio Platforms Ltd., the digital and telecommunications arm of RIL, had received regulatory approval for its initial public offering.
The Securities and Exchange Board of India issued an observation letter during the week ended August 28, effectively giving the company clearance to proceed with the IPO.

Jio Platforms, part of Reliance Industries Ltd., filed draft documents on June 19 for the offering. The IPO comprises as many as 270 million new shares, according to the prospectus. That would amount to a dilution of about 2.9% of the company’s equity, according to Bloomberg News calculations.
The draft prospectus said net proceeds from the share sale will be used to repay debt and for general corporate purposes.
The Akash Ambani-led firm plans to use the IPO proceeds to repay about Rs 27,500 crore of Reliance Jio Infocomm's debt.
Jio may launch its estimated $4-billion IPO by the end of October or early November, Economic Times reported earlier on September 4 citing sources.
Jio is likely to finalise the exact dates within a couple of weeks after which it would initiate roadshows overseas before holding them at home, the report added citing a source.
